description: Fork of exp294 (val=1.6636 @ 451M). Single trade in out_proj: NAP 6 -> 10, tph_per_layer /= 16. tph: [8192,8192,4096,4096,4096,4096] -> [512,512,256,256,256,256]. Table entries per layer preserved exactly (tph * 2^NAP same), so param count ~unchanged (~451M). Tests deeper anchor-pair count + fatter tables vs shallow-many. Backward mode switched to multi-alt n_alt=3 (NAP=10 soft would OOM). Uses train.py from exp293 (out_backward_mode switch).
